messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: sustained error rate and token queueing on /v1/embeddings-hot. 5xxs and latency > 20s for affected requests. Auto-mitigation suggestions queued.
maya: I'm on it — picking up pager. joining call in 2.
raj: TL;DR — embeddings route is getting hammered by a small set of heavy clients, causing KV cache pressure and downstream queueing. Chat route unaffected so far.
lucy: Can we throttle the embeddings route and divert excess to embeddings-batch?
santiago: Yes — propose surgical per-endpoint quota cut to 60% for embeddings-hot and a temporary route cap: max_concurrent=120. That should free up GPU slots.
emily: +1. Also push a soft-disable for rerank on the same customer cohorts (they trigger reranks per doc). Rerank adds multiple calls per request.
maya: Applying changes now. Patch to routing rules:
```yaml
routes:
  - id: embeddings-hot
    quota: 0.6
    max_concurrent: 120
    fallback: embeddings-batch
  - id: chat-standard
    priority: high
```
Executing: `infractl route update embeddings-hot --quota 0.6 --max-concurrent 120 --fallback embeddings-batch`
ops-bot: Command accepted. Rolling update started (change-id: r-3612-qs).
raj: Monitor tail latency and queue depth. If 5xxs drop but latency stays high, we may need to enable request-level sampling to inspect payload sizes.
lucy: Rerank toggle: `feature-flag set client:acct-555 rerank=false --scope route:embeddings-hot`
santiago: I'll stage that, not global. Doing now.
ops-bot: Feature flag change applied for client acct-555.
emily: Noted increased errors from another tenant during the rollout — looks like a retry storm. Can we add stricter per-client QPS on embeddings-batch?
maya: Adding per-client QPS 10 -> 5 for heavy accounts temporarily. Command: `quota adjust --route embeddings-batch --client acct-555 --qps 5`
ops-bot: Quota updated.
raj: Handoff: maya taking lead for the next 30m, I'll stay available for rollback and telemetry. maya -> oncall primary.
maya: Handoff ack. Current metrics: 5xx rate halved in last 3 minutes, median latency down from 24s -> 8s, queue depth reduced by ~65%. Still watching large-token requests.
lucy: Customer-impact note: two enterprise customers reported degraded embeddings ingestion (delays). We should message CS with ETA and mitigation steps.
emily: Drafting short blurb for status page: "We experienced elevated latency on embeddings ingestion routes; we've applied temporary per-route and per-client quotas and disabled per-request reranking for affected accounts. Service is stabilizing"
santiago: If stabilization continues, plan to gradually relax quotas in 15m increments. Keep rerank disabled until we confirm no regression.
maya: Agree. Also creating an incident timeline in the tracker and tagging engineering leads.
raj: After stabilization, capture sample payloads and run eval on model to ensure no quality regression from rerank removal.
maya: Final check: all mitigation ops can be rolled back with `infractl route rollback r-3612-qs` or re-enable rerank with `feature-flag unset client:acct-555 rerank`. Will wait 30m before relaxing.
incident-bot: Incident status update: Mitigations applied. Severity: elevated -> mitigated. Next update at +30m or on changes.
maya: Thanks team. ping me if any spike.
lucy: Filing customer notifications and post-incident writeup. :thumbsup:
raj: Putting a follow-up to tune automatic shedding thresholds to avoid manual per-client QPS tweaks in future.
ops-bot: Runbook checkpoint: saved runbook snapshot at 3612345849 (runbook:v2).
maya: closing handoff — leaving thread open for postmortem notes.
